market_summary: US100 displays strong bullish momentum above VAH and VWAP during the New York session, providing a high-confluence long setup. Gold (XAUUSD), EURUSD, and GBPUSD remain locked in post-selloff consolidations inside value areas or near session lows, while BTCUSD consolidates below Session High with mild CVD divergence. Focus remains on index trend continuation.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4028.54) and below POC (4043.68). CVD is BEARISH (-2.57) with negative slope (-0.48), confirming strong selling pressure. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (4036.31) and EMA50 (4027.04), stretching down near lower ATR band (3997.52). However, RVOL is currently 0.721 (low volume after prior selloff spike) and price is bouncing slightly off the Session Low support (3987.10) mid-forming bar. Extended move demands pullback before shorting.

Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.10824..VAH 1.11472), hovering right near POC (1.10920). CVD is BEARISH (-14,289) but short-term slope is positive (+4312.06). NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is below VWAP (1.11261) and EMA50 (1.11192), sitting in the middle of the ATR channel. Volume is low (RVOL 0.536). Trading inside the value area near fair value magnet (POC) with conflicting momentum suggests ranging consolidation. Prefer HOLD.

Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.32661..VAH 1.33251), below POC (1.32813). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,859). NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades below VWAP (1.33071) and EMA50 (1.33021), near the lower ATR band. RVOL is low (0.406). The market held Session Low support at 1.32661 and is rebounding weakly into mid-channel inside the value area. Lacks strong breakout volume or CVD alignment for a fresh directional trigger.

Price is above VAH (28337.86) and well above POC (28264.82). CVD is BULLISH (+13.39), supporting the upward trend. NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is cleanly above VWAP (28190.61) and EMA50 (28277.38). EMA20 (28408.39) is sloping up strongly. Price is pushing upper ATR band (28533.33) near Session High (28565.11). While index tick volume rarely prints RVOL > 2.0 (current RVOL 0.876), structural trend and value area expansion strongly favor buying dips towards EMA20/forming bar open.
